title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. Live starts: v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026 and v006 from 9 October 2026. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. In testing, losses were common and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. 1 trade says nothing about a strategy.

## Open positions and closed trades

The engines' own state is recorded as follows. htf-rsi-v007 has 0 positions open on paper and 4 closed trades so far, with an average null net per trade. trend-daily-v005 has the Bitcoin market filter off, 0 positions open on paper, and 6 closed trades so far, with an average -13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 also has the Bitcoin market filter off, 0 positions open on paper, and 7 closed trades so far, with an average -13.34% net per trade. The record also notes a NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 that has been open since. These entries are paper signals, not real orders. A single closed trade, or a short run of closed trades, does not by itself establish what a strategy will do next. The averages printed above are descriptions of trades already recorded, not forecasts.

## Most recent exits

The most recent recorded exits are as follows. trend-daily-v005: UNIUSDT on 2026-11-06, -10.91% net, closed on regime. trend-daily-v006: HYPEUSDT on 2026-11-06, -14.08% net, closed on breakdown; and UNIUSDT on 2026-11-06, -10.91% net, closed on regime. The record gives the exit reason as recorded, namely closed on regime or closed on breakdown, and does not provide a deeper narrative for either exit. ATOM's earlier exit is recorded separately: it exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. Each of these results is a historical paper result. It is not evidence that the next trade will follow the same path.

## Distance to 20-day breakouts

For both trend engines, the symbols closest to their 20-day breakout are recorded with the same distances. ZECUSDT is 2.63% below its high. BCHUSDT is 8.00% below its high. BNBUSDT is 9.23% below its high. These distances describe where those symbols stand relative to their highs at the time of the snapshot. They do not, by themselves, say whether an entry will occur, because the Bitcoin market filter is recorded as off for both trend-daily-v005 and trend-daily-v006 and both show 0 positions open on paper. The record does not state a rule for how the filter interacts with these distances, so no causal claim is made here.

## Reading the snapshot

This live snapshot was read at 2026-11-06T08:34:03.753Z. The record updates continuously, and the same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. The framing remains unchanged throughout: paper signals only, no real orders are placed anywhere in this record. Live starts remain v005 from 1 October 2026 and v006 from 9 October 2026. The first live signal remains the ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. The NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 remains open. The closed-trade averages remain -13.22% net per trade for v005 across 6 trades and -13.34% net per trade for v006 across 7 trades. htf-rsi-v007 remains at 0 positions open on paper with 4 closed trades and an average null net per trade. Nothing in this snapshot should be read as a prediction, a recommendation, or a statement that any coin or trade will behave a certain way.
